scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible JSON chunks.

summary.scope: Fixed-weld finer contact force tails, complete actual full-arm inputs, fixed-polyhedron qualifications and exact sparse-inertia equivalence

contact_tail.scope: Audit raw rigid penetration and fixed-step contact-regularization sensitivity.
contact_tail.limitations: Raw collider penetration is a solver-regularization observable, not material deformation. The independent body mesh agrees with runtime collision vertices within the declared geometry guard. Force/depth ratios are state diagnostics, not a universal contact stiffness; dynamics and solver impedance also contribute. Contact-only time constants change at fixed geometry, material, actuation, integration interval and recorded temporary-weld parameters. Three levels do not by themselves establish a credible zero-regularization tail. The body may retain angular motion; solved deformable/dynamic contact, support/history matching and native load replay remain required before interpreting deformation feedback or physical operating range.

full_application_controls.scope: Audit full-arm identical-input contact-law changes at dense common times.
full_application_controls.limitations: These are actual full seven-arm-joint rigid-application captures, with identical saved conditions and controller/mass inputs. Per-geom contact regularization is the changed axis. Two contact-law settings do not establish a convergence tail. Dense hand/joint/force/geometry data enables corresponding reference construction; it is not a solved deformable full-arm comparison or physical accuracy/cost acceptance. Hand motion and angular body motion remain explicit.

full_input_geometry.scope: Audit captured rigid wrenches, temporal settling and complete finger geometry.
full_input_geometry.limitations: Wrench moments are scaled by fixed20mm solely for rank/residual diagnostics. Unconstrained point-force span is an outer support test, not a friction-cone feasibility or global grasp impossibility claim. Contact birth, geometry/pose changes and finite contact moments can change support. No stationary frame is accepted from translational speed alone; angular motion, six-component equilibrium and temporal trends remain explicit. All12 finger geoms must be retained in corresponding references.

sparse_constructor.scope: Check byte-equivalent mass entries and active force/tangent under sparse assembly.
sparse_constructor.limitations: Exact matrix/active-equation equivalence qualifies the constructor replacement, not finer-mesh physical accuracy. The original source and long jobs remain unchanged; the isolated runner records actual executable snapshots. Runtime memory/cost on larger refinements requires its own measured evidence.

cold_protocol_exact_arrays.scope: Complete held cold closure and80 inertial steps, reference geometry and raw full body tensor/peak fields. ZIP metadata is excluded; every original npy payload is exact.

summary.full_egg_failure: Terminal lagged-friction initialization failure at increment384. Original input/current/previous states and exact logs are retained; same-state current-force numerical recovery is live and excluded.

limitations: Finer normal-force tails are measured at fixed actual weld/integration parameters; they are not full stress/contact-area/shear or spatial acceptance. Complete full-arm actual inputs are qualified but not a deformable full-arm solve. Two fixed-polyhedron spatial qualifications and exact sparse-constructor/83-NPZ-array cold-protocol equivalence are qualified. Fine spatial tasks and original U remain live/excluded. Original full-egg initialization fails, and its same-state recovery remains unverified. Full matched support/history/arm/contact/spatial, load-model/feedback, extrema and physical accuracy/cost acceptance remain required. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
